title: viya-cli workflow user config
description: User-level workflow defaults for viya-cli. Store this under ~/.viya-cli/workflow.yaml or pass --user-config. Do not include secrets.

contextId.description: User-level default Compute context ID. Project workflow contextId overrides this value.

contextName.description: User-level default Compute context name. Project workflow contextName overrides this value.

autoexec.description: SAS code sent as Compute session initCode.

preCode.description: SAS code prepended before each work item's code.

postCode.description: SAS code appended after each work item's code.

variables.description: Non-secret variables available as Compute variables and SAS macro variables.
